This is a numerical rejection and bounded compatibility investigation, not a qualified backend or performance comparison.
Two-CTA racecheck harness labels still say all_600_tiles for the random case; actual code launches two CTAs and checks only 512 columns. The separate sync_full case covers all600 tiles.
The early three-stage probe binary was built before the patch; pipe2/race binaries before synchronization; sync binaries after synchronization. Reproducing each negative control requires its corresponding header state.
Absolute OS-temporary paths identify the original run. Use equivalent paths when extracting the frozen source. Generated CUDA and commands below reproduce the selected native variant with the pinned upstream includes and patch. Original oracle creation is in qualify_generation.py; no expected output was revised after a failure.

JSON receipts are reserialized with scalar arrays on one line; parsed values are unchanged. Patch text is JSON-encoded to preserve unified-diff context spaces. Other text has only trailing horizontal whitespace normalized.

===== qualify_generation.py =====
import pathlib,json,time,gc,threading,traceback,sys
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM,AutoTokenizer
from mirage.engine.model_runner import ModelRunner,RunnerConfig
from mirage.mpk.mpk import MPK,MPKMetadata
from mirage.mpk.online_pinned_runtime import OnlinePinnedRuntime
from mirage.mpk.models.graph_builder import MirageModelConfig

base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/bpfusion-mpk-asg8ix4p')
snapshot=pathlib.Path('/workspaces/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B/snapshots/c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca')
torch.cuda.set_device(0)
tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(snapshot,local_files_only=True)
prompts=[[17],tokenizer.encode('The capital of France is'),tokenizer.encode('Please answer briefly: what is 1 + 1?'),tokenizer.encode('请用一句话介绍你自己。')]
receipt={'model':'Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B','revision':snapshot.name,'backend_revision':'f9eb70c254acefc9f3667b2a973d0dcf25471fce','device':torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),'capability':torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0),'dtype':'bfloat16','qualification_only':True,'cases':[]}
print('ORACLE_START',flush=True)
oracle=AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(snapshot,local_files_only=True,torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,attn_implementation='eager').to('cuda').eval()
oracles=[]
with torch.inference_mode():
 for ids in prompts:
  x=torch.tensor([ids],device='cuda',dtype=torch.int64)
  out=oracle.generate(input_ids=x,attention_mask=torch.ones_like(x),do_sample=False,max_new_tokens=32,pad_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id)
  oracles.append(out[0,len(ids):].cpu().tolist())
receipt['oracles']=oracles
(base/'qualification_oracle.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
del out,x,oracle;gc.collect();torch.cuda.empty_cache()
print('ORACLE_DONE',[len(x) for x in oracles],flush=True)

cfg=RunnerConfig(model='Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B')
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.bfloat16)
meta=ModelRunner._allocate_meta_tensors(cfg)
mpk=MPK(MPKMetadata(mode='online_pinned',total_num_requests=cfg.max_num_batched_requests,max_seq_length=cfg.max_seq_length,max_num_batched_requests=cfg.max_num_batched_requests,max_num_batched_tokens=cfg.max_num_batched_tokens,max_num_pages=cfg.max_num_pages,page_size=cfg.page_size,pinned_ring_capacity=cfg.pinned_ring_capacity,world_size=1,rank=0,weight_from_model=True,model_name=cfg.model,model_config=MirageModelConfig(with_lm_head=True),use_cutlass_kernel=cfg.use_cutlass_kernel,do_sample=cfg.do_sample,temperature=cfg.temperature,top_p=cfg.top_p,top_k=cfg.top_k,sampling_seed=cfg.sampling_seed,sampling_topk_max=cfg.sampling_topk_max,**meta))
mpk.build()
mpk.persistent_kernel.load_mpk_kernel(str(base/'qualified_kernel'),eos_token_id=mpk.model_builder.eos_token_id)
mpk.is_compiled=True
runtime=OnlinePinnedRuntime(mpk)
runtime.reset()
torch.cuda.synchronize()
errors=[]
def run():
 try:
  mpk()
  mpk.persistent_kernel.wait()
 except BaseException as e:
  errors.append(repr(e));traceback.print_exc()
thread=threading.Thread(target=run,daemon=True)
runtime.start();thread.start()
print('RESIDENT_LAUNCHED',flush=True)
try:
 for wave in range(3):
  rids=[wave*4+j for j in range(4)]
  for rid,ids in zip(rids,prompts):
   runtime.submit(rid,torch.tensor(ids,dtype=torch.int64))
  for rid,ids,expected in zip(rids,prompts,oracles):
   row,final=runtime.wait_for_request(rid,timeout=60)
   got=runtime.read_tokens_at_row(row,final).cpu().tolist()
   generated=got[len(ids):]
   prefix=generated[:len(expected)]
   exact=prefix==expected
   divergence=next((i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(prefix,expected)) if a!=b),None)
   case={'rid':rid,'row':row,'final_step':final,'prompt':ids,'got_prefix':prefix,'expected':expected,'prefix_exact':exact,'first_divergence':divergence,'generated_length':len(generated)}
   receipt['cases'].append(case)
   print('CASE',json.dumps(case,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
   runtime.release_request(rid)
  (base/'qualification_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
finally:
 print('SHUTDOWN_REQUESTED',flush=True)
 runtime.request_shutdown();thread.join(timeout=60)
 receipt['kernel_thread_stopped']=not thread.is_alive()
 receipt['kernel_errors']=errors
 if not thread.is_alive():runtime.stop()
 receipt['all_prefixes_exact']=len(receipt['cases'])==12 and all(x['prefix_exact'] for x in receipt['cases'])
 (base/'qualification_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
 print('QUALIFICATION_RESULT',receipt['all_prefixes_exact'],'stopped',receipt['kernel_thread_stopped'],'errors',errors,flush=True)
 if thread.is_alive():raise RuntimeError('Kernel shutdown has not completed; preserve process for diagnosis')
mpk.persistent_kernel.finalize()

===== qualify_runner.py =====
import pathlib,traceback,json,time
import torch
from mirage.engine.model_runner import ModelRunner,RunnerConfig
base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/bpfusion-mpk-asg8ix4p')
snapshot='/workspaces/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B/snapshots/c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca'
print('DEVICE',torch.cuda.get_device_name(),torch.cuda.get_device_capability(),flush=True)
t=time.monotonic()
try:
 runner=ModelRunner(RunnerConfig(model='Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B',output_dir=str(base/'qualified_kernel')))
 print('MODEL_RUNNER_COMPILED',time.monotonic()-t,flush=True)
except BaseException:
 traceback.print_exc()
 raise

===== head_probe/head_probe.cu =====
#include "tasks/ampere/linear_cutlass.cuh"
#include <cstdio>
__global__ __launch_bounds__(128, 1)
void head_probe(void const *a, void const *b, void *c, int active) {
  kernel::linear_kernel<kernel::bfloat16, 8, 256, 1024, 153600>(
    a, static_cast<char const *>(b) + blockIdx.x * 256ull * 1024 * 2,
    nullptr, static_cast<char *>(c) + blockIdx.x * 256ull * 2, active, false);
}
extern "C" int run_head(void const *a, void const *b, void *c, int active) {
  auto e = cudaFuncSetAttribute(head_probe, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, 98304);
  if (e != cudaSuccess) { fprintf(stderr, "ATTRIBUTE %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e)); return e; }
  head_probe<<<600, 128, 98304>>>(a,b,c,active);
  e = cudaGetLastError();
  if (e != cudaSuccess) { fprintf(stderr, "LAUNCH %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e)); return e; }
  e = cudaDeviceSynchronize();
  fprintf(stderr, "HEAD_SYNC %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e));
  return e;
}

===== head_probe/run_probe.py =====
import ctypes,json,time,torch
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('/tmp/bpfusion-mpk-asg8ix4p/head_probe')
torch.cuda.set_device(0)
a=torch.ones((8,1024),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
w=torch.ones((153600,1024),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
o=torch.zeros((8,153600),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
torch.cuda.synchronize()
fn=ctypes.CDLL(str(b/'head_probe.so')).run_head
fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int]
fn.restype=ctypes.c_int
rc=fn(a.data_ptr(),w.data_ptr(),o.data_ptr(),8)
receipt={'variant':'upstream_cutlass_pipe3','shared_required_bytes':110592,'shared_allocated_bytes':98304,'return_code':rc}
if rc==0:
 receipt['all_outputs_exact']=bool(torch.all(o==1024).item())
(b/'memcheck_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if rc==0 and receipt.get('all_outputs_exact') else 1)

===== head_probe_pipe2/diagnostic.py =====
import ctypes,json,torch
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('/tmp/bpfusion-mpk-asg8ix4p/head_probe_pipe2')
torch.cuda.set_device(0);torch.manual_seed(17)
fn=ctypes.CDLL(str(b/'head_probe.so')).run_head
fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int];fn.restype=ctypes.c_int
cases=[]
a=torch.ones((8,1024),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
w=torch.ones((153600,1024),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
o=torch.zeros((8,153600),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
torch.cuda.synchronize()
rc=fn(a.data_ptr(),w.data_ptr(),o.data_ptr(),8)
cases.append({'name':'constant_all_600_tiles','return_code':rc,'exact':rc==0 and bool(torch.all(o==1024).item()),'unique_values':torch.unique(o).cpu().tolist()[:24],'mismatches_by_row':torch.count_nonzero(o!=1024,dim=1).cpu().tolist(),'mismatches_by_tile_half':[int(torch.count_nonzero(o.reshape(8,600,256)[:,:,j:j+128]!=1024).item()) for j in [0,128]],'first_tile_rows':o[:2,:256:8].cpu().tolist()})
if rc==0:
 a.copy_(torch.randint(-4,5,a.shape,device='cuda').to(torch.bfloat16)/8)
 w.copy_(torch.randint(-4,5,w.shape,device='cuda').to(torch.bfloat16)/8)
 expected=torch.matmul(a,w.T);o.zero_();torch.cuda.synchronize()
 rc=fn(a.data_ptr(),w.data_ptr(),o.data_ptr(),8)
 cases.append({'name':'dyadic_random_rows_all_600_tiles','return_code':rc,
               'mismatches':int(torch.count_nonzero(o!=expected).item()) if rc==0 else None,'mismatches_by_tile_half':[int(torch.count_nonzero((o!=expected).reshape(8,600,256)[:,:,j:j+128]).item()) for j in [0,128]],
               'exact':rc==0 and bool(torch.equal(o,expected))})
receipt={'variant':'upstream_cutlass_pipe2','shared_required_bytes':73728,'shared_allocated_bytes':98304,'cases':cases,'all_exact':len(cases)==2 and all(c['exact'] for c in cases)}
(b/'diagnostic_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2));print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if receipt['all_exact'] else 1)

===== head_probe_pipe2/head_probe.cu =====
#include "tasks/ampere/linear_cutlass.cuh"
#include <cstdio>
__global__ __launch_bounds__(128, 1)
void head_probe(void const *a, void const *b, void *c, int active) {
  kernel::linear_kernel<kernel::bfloat16, 8, 256, 1024, 153600, 2>(
    a, static_cast<char const *>(b) + blockIdx.x * 256ull * 1024 * 2,
    nullptr, static_cast<char *>(c) + blockIdx.x * 256ull * 2, active, false);
}
extern "C" int run_head(void const *a, void const *b, void *c, int active) {
  auto e = cudaFuncSetAttribute(head_probe, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, 98304);
  if (e != cudaSuccess) { fprintf(stderr, "ATTRIBUTE %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e)); return e; }
  head_probe<<<600, 128, 98304>>>(a,b,c,active);
  e = cudaGetLastError();
  if (e != cudaSuccess) { fprintf(stderr, "LAUNCH %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e)); return e; }
  e = cudaDeviceSynchronize();
  fprintf(stderr, "HEAD_SYNC %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e));
  return e;
}

===== head_probe_race/head_probe.cu =====
#include "tasks/ampere/linear_cutlass.cuh"
#include <cstdio>
__global__ __launch_bounds__(128, 1)
void head_probe(void const *a, void const *b, void *c, int active) {
  kernel::linear_kernel<kernel::bfloat16, 8, 256, 1024, 153600, 2>(
    a, static_cast<char const *>(b) + blockIdx.x * 256ull * 1024 * 2,
    nullptr, static_cast<char *>(c) + blockIdx.x * 256ull * 2, active, false);
}
extern "C" int run_head(void const *a, void const *b, void *c, int active) {
  auto e = cudaFuncSetAttribute(head_probe, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, 98304);
  if (e != cudaSuccess) { fprintf(stderr, "ATTRIBUTE %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e)); return e; }
  head_probe<<<2, 128, 98304>>>(a,b,c,active);
  e = cudaGetLastError();
  if (e != cudaSuccess) { fprintf(stderr, "LAUNCH %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e)); return e; }
  e = cudaDeviceSynchronize();
  fprintf(stderr, "HEAD_SYNC %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e));
  return e;
}

===== head_probe_sync/head_probe.cu =====
#include "tasks/ampere/linear_cutlass.cuh"
#include <cstdio>
__global__ __launch_bounds__(128, 1)
void head_probe(void const *a, void const *b, void *c, int active) {
  kernel::linear_kernel<kernel::bfloat16, 8, 256, 1024, 153600, 2>(
    a, static_cast<char const *>(b) + blockIdx.x * 256ull * 1024 * 2,
    nullptr, static_cast<char *>(c) + blockIdx.x * 256ull * 2, active, false);
}
extern "C" int run_head(void const *a, void const *b, void *c, int active) {
  auto e = cudaFuncSetAttribute(head_probe, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, 98304);
  if (e != cudaSuccess) { fprintf(stderr, "ATTRIBUTE %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e)); return e; }
  head_probe<<<2, 128, 98304>>>(a,b,c,active);
  e = cudaGetLastError();
  if (e != cudaSuccess) { fprintf(stderr, "LAUNCH %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e)); return e; }
  e = cudaDeviceSynchronize();
  fprintf(stderr, "HEAD_SYNC %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e));
  return e;
}

===== head_probe_sync/run_probe.py =====
import ctypes,json,torch
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('/tmp/bpfusion-mpk-asg8ix4p/head_probe_sync')
torch.cuda.set_device(0);torch.manual_seed(17)
fn=ctypes.CDLL(str(b/'head_probe.so')).run_head
fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_int];fn.restype=ctypes.c_int
cases=[]
a=torch.ones((8,1024),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
w=torch.ones((153600,1024),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
o=torch.zeros((8,153600),device='cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16)
torch.cuda.synchronize()
rc=fn(a.data_ptr(),w.data_ptr(),o.data_ptr(),8)
cases.append({'name':'constant_first_two_tiles','return_code':rc,'exact':rc==0 and bool(torch.all(o[:,:512]==1024).item())})
if rc==0:
 a.copy_(torch.randint(-4,5,a.shape,device='cuda').to(torch.bfloat16)/8)
 w.copy_(torch.randint(-4,5,w.shape,device='cuda').to(torch.bfloat16)/8)
 expected=torch.matmul(a,w.T);o.zero_();torch.cuda.synchronize()
 rc=fn(a.data_ptr(),w.data_ptr(),o.data_ptr(),8)
 cases.append({'name':'dyadic_random_rows_all_600_tiles','return_code':rc,
               'mismatches':int(torch.count_nonzero(o[:,:512]!=expected[:,:512]).item()) if rc==0 else None,
               'exact':rc==0 and bool(torch.equal(o[:,:512],expected[:,:512]))})
receipt={'variant':'upstream_cutlass_pipe2','shared_required_bytes':73728,'shared_allocated_bytes':98304,'cases':cases,'all_exact':len(cases)==2 and all(c['exact'] for c in cases)}
(b/'racecheck_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2));print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if receipt['all_exact'] else 1)

===== head_probe_sync_full/head_probe.cu =====
#include "tasks/ampere/linear_cutlass.cuh"
#include <cstdio>
__global__ __launch_bounds__(128, 1)
void head_probe(void const *a, void const *b, void *c, int active) {
  kernel::linear_kernel<kernel::bfloat16, 8, 256, 1024, 153600, 2>(
    a, static_cast<char const *>(b) + blockIdx.x * 256ull * 1024 * 2,
    nullptr, static_cast<char *>(c) + blockIdx.x * 256ull * 2, active, false);
}
extern "C" int run_head(void const *a, void const *b, void *c, int active) {
  auto e = cudaFuncSetAttribute(head_probe, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, 98304);
  if (e != cudaSuccess) { fprintf(stderr, "ATTRIBUTE %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e)); return e; }
  head_probe<<<600, 128, 98304>>>(a,b,c,active);
  e = cudaGetLastError();
  if (e != cudaSuccess) { fprintf(stderr, "LAUNCH %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e)); return e; }
  e = cudaDeviceSynchronize();
  fprintf(stderr, "HEAD_SYNC %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(e));
  return e;
}

torch.cuda.synchronize()

cases.append({'name':'constant_all_600_tiles','return_code':rc,'exact':rc==0 and bool(torch.all(o==1024).item())})
if rc==0:
 a.copy_(torch.randint(-4,5,a.shape,device='cuda').to(torch.bfloat16)/8)

===== synced_kernel/qualify_generation.py =====
import pathlib,json,time,gc,threading,traceback,sys
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM,AutoTokenizer
from mirage.engine.model_runner import ModelRunner,RunnerConfig
from mirage.mpk.mpk import MPK,MPKMetadata
from mirage.mpk.online_pinned_runtime import OnlinePinnedRuntime
from mirage.mpk.models.graph_builder import MirageModelConfig

base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/bpfusion-mpk-asg8ix4p')
snapshot=pathlib.Path('/workspaces/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B/snapshots/c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca')
torch.cuda.set_device(0)
tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(snapshot,local_files_only=True)
prompts=[[17],tokenizer.encode('The capital of France is'),tokenizer.encode('Please answer briefly: what is 1 + 1?'),tokenizer.encode('请用一句话介绍你自己。')]
receipt={'model':'Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B','revision':snapshot.name,'backend_revision':'f9eb70c254acefc9f3667b2a973d0dcf25471fce','device':torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),'capability':torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0),'dtype':'bfloat16','qualification_only':True,'cases':[]}
oracles=json.loads((base/'qualification_oracle.json').read_text())['oracles']
print('REUSE_PINNED_HF_ORACLE',flush=True)

cfg=RunnerConfig(model='Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B')
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.bfloat16)
meta=ModelRunner._allocate_meta_tensors(cfg)
mpk=MPK(MPKMetadata(mode='online_pinned',total_num_requests=cfg.max_num_batched_requests,max_seq_length=cfg.max_seq_length,max_num_batched_requests=cfg.max_num_batched_requests,max_num_batched_tokens=cfg.max_num_batched_tokens,max_num_pages=cfg.max_num_pages,page_size=cfg.page_size,pinned_ring_capacity=cfg.pinned_ring_capacity,world_size=1,rank=0,weight_from_model=True,model_name=cfg.model,model_config=MirageModelConfig(with_lm_head=True),use_cutlass_kernel=cfg.use_cutlass_kernel,do_sample=cfg.do_sample,temperature=cfg.temperature,top_p=cfg.top_p,top_k=cfg.top_k,sampling_seed=cfg.sampling_seed,sampling_topk_max=cfg.sampling_topk_max,**meta))
mpk.build()
mpk.persistent_kernel.load_mpk_kernel(str(base/'synced_kernel'),eos_token_id=mpk.model_builder.eos_token_id)
mpk.is_compiled=True
runtime=OnlinePinnedRuntime(mpk)
runtime.reset()
torch.cuda.synchronize()
errors=[]
def run():
 try:
  mpk()
  mpk.persistent_kernel.wait()
 except BaseException as e:
  errors.append(repr(e));traceback.print_exc()
thread=threading.Thread(target=run,daemon=True)
runtime.start();thread.start()
print('RESIDENT_LAUNCHED',flush=True)
try:
 for wave in range(3):
  rids=[wave*4+j for j in range(4)]
  for rid,ids in zip(rids,prompts):
   runtime.submit(rid,torch.tensor(ids,dtype=torch.int64))
  for rid,ids,expected in zip(rids,prompts,oracles):
   row,final=runtime.wait_for_request(rid,timeout=60)
   got=runtime.read_tokens_at_row(row,final).cpu().tolist()
   generated=got[len(ids):]
   prefix=generated[:len(expected)]
   exact=prefix==expected
   divergence=next((i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(prefix,expected)) if a!=b),None)
   case={'rid':rid,'row':row,'final_step':final,'prompt':ids,'got_tokens':got,'generated_tokens':generated,'got_prefix':prefix,'expected':expected,'prefix_exact':exact,'first_divergence':divergence,'generated_length':len(generated)}
   receipt['cases'].append(case)
   print('CASE',json.dumps(case,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
   runtime.release_request(rid)
  (base/'qualification_synced_progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
finally:
 print('SHUTDOWN_REQUESTED',flush=True)
 runtime.request_shutdown();thread.join(timeout=60)
 receipt['kernel_thread_stopped']=not thread.is_alive()
 receipt['kernel_errors']=errors
 if not thread.is_alive():runtime.stop()
 receipt['all_prefixes_exact']=len(receipt['cases'])==12 and all(x['prefix_exact'] for x in receipt['cases'])
 (base/'qualification_synced_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
 print('QUALIFICATION_RESULT',receipt['all_prefixes_exact'],'stopped',receipt['kernel_thread_stopped'],'errors',errors,flush=True)
 if thread.is_alive():raise RuntimeError('Kernel shutdown has not completed; preserve process for diagnosis')
mpk.persistent_kernel.finalize()

===== synced_kernel/qualify_serial.py =====
import pathlib,json,time,gc,threading,traceback,sys
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM,AutoTokenizer
from mirage.engine.model_runner import ModelRunner,RunnerConfig
from mirage.mpk.mpk import MPK,MPKMetadata
from mirage.mpk.online_pinned_runtime import OnlinePinnedRuntime
from mirage.mpk.models.graph_builder import MirageModelConfig

base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/bpfusion-mpk-asg8ix4p')
snapshot=pathlib.Path('/workspaces/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B/snapshots/c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca')
torch.cuda.set_device(0)
tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(snapshot,local_files_only=True)
prompts=[[17],tokenizer.encode('The capital of France is'),tokenizer.encode('Please answer briefly: what is 1 + 1?'),tokenizer.encode('请用一句话介绍你自己。')]
receipt={'model':'Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B','revision':snapshot.name,'backend_revision':'f9eb70c254acefc9f3667b2a973d0dcf25471fce','device':torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),'capability':torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0),'dtype':'bfloat16','qualification_only':True,'submission_order':'serial, unchanged capacity and compiled kernel','cases':[]}
oracles=json.loads((base/'qualification_oracle.json').read_text())['oracles']
print('REUSE_PINNED_HF_ORACLE',flush=True)

cfg=RunnerConfig(model='Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B')
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.bfloat16)
meta=ModelRunner._allocate_meta_tensors(cfg)
mpk=MPK(MPKMetadata(mode='online_pinned',total_num_requests=cfg.max_num_batched_requests,max_seq_length=cfg.max_seq_length,max_num_batched_requests=cfg.max_num_batched_requests,max_num_batched_tokens=cfg.max_num_batched_tokens,max_num_pages=cfg.max_num_pages,page_size=cfg.page_size,pinned_ring_capacity=cfg.pinned_ring_capacity,world_size=1,rank=0,weight_from_model=True,model_name=cfg.model,model_config=MirageModelConfig(with_lm_head=True),use_cutlass_kernel=cfg.use_cutlass_kernel,do_sample=cfg.do_sample,temperature=cfg.temperature,top_p=cfg.top_p,top_k=cfg.top_k,sampling_seed=cfg.sampling_seed,sampling_topk_max=cfg.sampling_topk_max,**meta))
mpk.build()
mpk.persistent_kernel.load_mpk_kernel(str(base/'synced_kernel'),eos_token_id=mpk.model_builder.eos_token_id)
mpk.is_compiled=True
runtime=OnlinePinnedRuntime(mpk)
runtime.reset()
torch.cuda.synchronize()
errors=[]
def run():
 try:
  mpk()
  mpk.persistent_kernel.wait()
 except BaseException as e:
  errors.append(repr(e));traceback.print_exc()
thread=threading.Thread(target=run,daemon=True)
runtime.start();thread.start()
print('RESIDENT_LAUNCHED',flush=True)
try:
 for wave in range(3):
  rids=[wave*4+j for j in range(4)]
  for rid,ids,expected in zip(rids,prompts,oracles):
   runtime.submit(rid,torch.tensor(ids,dtype=torch.int64))
   row,final=runtime.wait_for_request(rid,timeout=60)
   got=runtime.read_tokens_at_row(row,final).cpu().tolist()
   generated=got[len(ids):]
   prefix=generated[:len(expected)]
   exact=prefix==expected
   divergence=next((i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(prefix,expected)) if a!=b),None)
   case={'rid':rid,'row':row,'final_step':final,'prompt':ids,'got_tokens':got,'generated_tokens':generated,'got_prefix':prefix,'expected':expected,'prefix_exact':exact,'first_divergence':divergence,'generated_length':len(generated)}
   receipt['cases'].append(case)
   print('CASE',json.dumps(case,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
   runtime.release_request(rid)
  (base/'qualification_serial_progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
finally:
 print('SHUTDOWN_REQUESTED',flush=True)
 runtime.request_shutdown();thread.join(timeout=60)
 receipt['kernel_thread_stopped']=not thread.is_alive()
 receipt['kernel_errors']=errors
 if not thread.is_alive():runtime.stop()
 receipt['all_prefixes_exact']=len(receipt['cases'])==12 and all(x['prefix_exact'] for x in receipt['cases'])
 (base/'qualification_serial_result.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
 print('QUALIFICATION_RESULT',receipt['all_prefixes_exact'],'stopped',receipt['kernel_thread_stopped'],'errors',errors,flush=True)
 if thread.is_alive():raise RuntimeError('Kernel shutdown has not completed; preserve process for diagnosis')
mpk.persistent_kernel.finalize()

===== synced_kernel/test_rank0.cu =====
#include "persistent_kernel.cuh"
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
#include <fstream>
#include <filesystem>
using json = nlohmann::json;
using namespace mirage::runtime;

// Global variable for runtime JSON path (referenced by Python for kernel reuse)
std::string g_task_graph_json_path;

size_t get_event_id(int my_gpu_id, size_t event_pos, bool nvshmem_event) {
  size_t event_id = ((static_cast<size_t>(my_gpu_id) << 32) | event_pos);
  if (nvshmem_event) {
    event_id = event_id | EVENT_NVSHMEM_TAG;
  }
  return event_id;
}

void construct_task_graph(int num_gpus,
                          int my_gpu_id,
                          std::vector<FullTaskDesc> &all_tasks,
                          std::vector<EventDesc> &all_events,
                          std::vector<TaskId> &first_tasks,
                          std::map<std::string, void*> const &all_tensors) {
    std::string json_path = g_task_graph_json_path;
    if (json_path.empty()) {
        // Fall back to __FILE__ based path for backward compatibility
        std::filesystem::path file_path(__FILE__);
        json_path = file_path.parent_path().string()+"/task_graph.json";
    }
    std::ifstream json_file(json_path);
    if (!json_file.is_open()) {
        fprintf(stderr, "ERROR: Failed to open task graph JSON file: %s\n", json_path.c_str());
        abort();
    }
  nlohmann::json json_task_graph;
  json_file >> json_task_graph;
  for (json const &task : json_task_graph["all_tasks"]) {
    FullTaskDesc task_desc(static_cast<TaskType>(task.at("task_type")),
                task.at("variant_id"));
    task_desc.task_metadata.request_id = task.at("request_id").get<int>();
    task_desc.task_metadata.expert_offset = task.at("expert_offset").get<int>();
    task_desc.task_metadata.kv_idx = task.at("kv_idx").get<int>();
    task_desc.task_metadata.merge_task_offset = task.at("merge_task_offset").get<int>();
    task_desc.task_metadata.task_offset = task.at("task_offset").get<int>();
    if (task.at("trigger_event").is_number_integer()) {
      task_desc.trigger_event = task.at("trigger_event").get<unsigned long long int>();
    }
    else {
      assert(false);
    }
    if (task.at("dependent_event").is_number_integer()) {
      task_desc.dependent_event = task.at("dependent_event").get<unsigned long long int>();
    }
    else {
      assert(false);
    }
    task_desc.num_inputs = 0;
    for (json const &tensor : task["inputs"]) {
      TensorDesc input;
      std::string name = tensor.at("base_ptr").get<std::string>();
      assert(all_tensors.find(name) != all_tensors.end());
      off_t offset = tensor.at("offset").get<off_t>();
      input.base_ptr = static_cast<char*>(all_tensors.at(name))+offset;
      assert(tensor.at("dims").size() == tensor.at("strides").size());
      input.num_dims = tensor.at("dims").size();
      input.data_type = tensor.at("data_type").get<int>();
      for (int i = 0; i < input.num_dims; i++) {
        input.dim[i] = tensor["dims"][i].get<int>();
        input.stride[i] = tensor["strides"][i].get<int>();
      }
      task_desc.inputs[task_desc.num_inputs++] = input;
    }
    task_desc.num_outputs = 0;
    for (json const &tensor : task["outputs"]) {
      TensorDesc output;
      std::string name = tensor.at("base_ptr").get<std::string>();
      assert(all_tensors.find(name) != all_tensors.end());
      off_t offset = tensor.at("offset").get<off_t>();
      output.base_ptr = static_cast<char*>(all_tensors.at(name))+offset;
      assert(tensor.at("dims").size() == tensor.at("strides").size());
      output.num_dims = tensor.at("dims").size();
      output.data_type = tensor.at("data_type").get<int>();
      for (int i = 0; i < output.num_dims; i++) {
        output.dim[i] = tensor["dims"][i];
        output.stride[i] = tensor["strides"][i];
      }
      task_desc.outputs[task_desc.num_outputs++] = output;
    }
    #ifdef MPK_ENABLE_TMA
    if (task.at("task_type") > TASK_HOPPER_TASK_BEGIN && task.at("task_type") < TASK_HOPPER_TASK_END) {
      create_tma_desc_by_task(task_desc);
    }
    if (task.at("task_type") > TASK_SM100_TMA_START_TASK && task.at("task_type") < TASK_SM100_TMA_END_TASK) {
      create_tma_desc_by_task(task_desc);
    }
    if (task.at("task_type") == TASK_MLA_DECODE_SM100 || task.at("task_type") == TASK_MLA_MTP_DECODE_SM100 || task.at("task_type") == TASK_MLA_MTP_DECODE_TP2_SM100 || task.at("task_type") == TASK_MLA_MTP_DECODE_TP4_SM100 || task.at("task_type") == TASK_MLA_MTP_DECODE_TP8_SM100 || task.at("task_type") == TASK_MLA_PREFILL_TP8_SM100) {
      create_tma_desc_by_task(task_desc);
    }
    if (task.at("task_type") == TASK_LINEAR_FP8_SM100 || task.at("task_type") == TASK_LINEAR_FP8_WITH_RESIDUAL_SM100) {
      create_tma_desc_by_task(task_desc);
    }
    #endif
    all_tasks.push_back(task_desc);
  }
  for (json const &e : json_task_graph["all_events"]) {
    EventType event_type = static_cast<EventType>(e.at("event_type").get<int>());
    int num_triggers = e.at("num_triggers").get<int>();
    int first_task_id = e.at("first_task_id").get<int>();
    int last_task_id = e.at("last_task_id").get<int>();
    all_events.push_back(EventDesc(event_type, num_triggers, first_task_id, last_task_id));
  }
  for (json const &t : json_task_graph["first_tasks"]) {
    first_tasks.push_back(t.get<int>());
  }
}

static void _init_persistent_kernel(std::vector<FullTaskDesc> &all_tasks,
                                    std::vector<EventDesc> &all_events,
                                  std::vector<TaskId> &first_tasks,
                                  int num_gpus,
                                  int my_gpu_id,
                                  std::map<std::string, void*> const &model_tensors) {
  assert(num_gpus = 1);
  std::map<std::string, void*> all_tensors;
  char *input_token = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("input_token"));
  all_tensors["input_token"] = input_token;
  char *cos_position_embedding = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("cos_position_embedding"));
  all_tensors["cos_position_embedding"] = cos_position_embedding;
  char *sin_position_embedding = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("sin_position_embedding"));
  all_tensors["sin_position_embedding"] = sin_position_embedding;
  void *embed_out;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&embed_out, 16384));
  all_tensors["embed_out"] = embed_out;
  void *rmsnorm_out;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&rmsnorm_out, 16384));
  all_tensors["rmsnorm_out"] = rmsnorm_out;
  void *attn_in;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&attn_in, 65536));
  all_tensors["attn_in"] = attn_in;
  void *attn_out;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&attn_out, 32768));
  all_tensors["attn_out"] = attn_out;
  void *attn_proj_out;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&attn_proj_out, 16384));
  all_tensors["attn_proj_out"] = attn_proj_out;
  void *all_reduce_buf;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&all_reduce_buf, 16384));
  all_tensors["all_reduce_buf"] = all_reduce_buf;
  void *attn_allreduce_out;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&attn_allreduce_out, 16384));
  all_tensors["attn_allreduce_out"] = attn_allreduce_out;
  void *mlp_mid;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&mlp_mid, 98304));
  all_tensors["mlp_mid"] = mlp_mid;
  void *silu_mul_out;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&silu_mul_out, 49152));
  all_tensors["silu_mul_out"] = silu_mul_out;
  void *mlp_out;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&mlp_out, 16384));
  all_tensors["mlp_out"] = mlp_out;
  void *mlp_final;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&mlp_final, 16384));
  all_tensors["mlp_final"] = mlp_final;
  void *argmax_in;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&argmax_in, 2457600));
  all_tensors["argmax_in"] = argmax_in;
  void *argmax_part_value;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&argmax_part_value, 2304));
  all_tensors["argmax_part_value"] = argmax_part_value;
  void *argmax_part_index;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&argmax_part_index, 9216));
  all_tensors["argmax_part_index"] = argmax_part_index;
  char *output_token = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("output_token"));
  all_tensors["output_token"] = output_token;
  char *embed_tokens = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("embed_tokens"));
  all_tensors["embed_tokens"] = embed_tokens;
  char *layer_0_input_layernorm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_0_input_layernorm"));
  all_tensors["layer_0_input_layernorm"] = layer_0_input_layernorm;
  char *layer_0_qkv_proj;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&layer_0_qkv_proj, 8388608));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_0_qkv_proj + 0), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_0_q_proj"), 524288, 524288, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_0_qkv_proj + 524288), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_0_k_proj"), 262144, 262144, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_0_qkv_proj + 786432), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_0_v_proj"), 262144, 262144, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  all_tensors["layer_0_qkv_proj"] = layer_0_qkv_proj;
  char *layer_0_q_norm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_0_q_norm"));
  all_tensors["layer_0_q_norm"] = layer_0_q_norm;

  all_tensors["layer_24_down_proj"] = layer_24_down_proj;
  char *layer_25_input_layernorm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_25_input_layernorm"));
  all_tensors["layer_25_input_layernorm"] = layer_25_input_layernorm;
  char *layer_25_qkv_proj;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&layer_25_qkv_proj, 8388608));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_25_qkv_proj + 0), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_25_q_proj"), 524288, 524288, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_25_qkv_proj + 524288), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_25_k_proj"), 262144, 262144, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_25_qkv_proj + 786432), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_25_v_proj"), 262144, 262144, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));

  char *layer_25_k_cache = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_25_k_cache"));

  char *layer_25_v_cache = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_25_v_cache"));

  char *layer_25_o_proj = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_25_o_proj"));
  all_tensors["layer_25_o_proj"] = layer_25_o_proj;
  char *layer_25_post_attn_layernorm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_25_post_attn_layernorm"));
  all_tensors["layer_25_post_attn_layernorm"] = layer_25_post_attn_layernorm;
  char *layer_25_gatedup_proj;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&layer_25_gatedup_proj, 12582912));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_25_gatedup_proj + 0), 262144, model_tensors.at("layer_25_gate_proj"), 131072, 131072, 48, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_25_gatedup_proj + 131072), 262144, model_tensors.at("layer_25_up_proj"), 131072, 131072, 48, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  all_tensors["layer_25_gatedup_proj"] = layer_25_gatedup_proj;
  char *layer_25_down_proj = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_25_down_proj"));
  all_tensors["layer_25_down_proj"] = layer_25_down_proj;

  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_26_qkv_proj + 0), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_26_q_proj"), 524288, 524288, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_26_qkv_proj + 524288), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_26_k_proj"), 262144, 262144, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_26_qkv_proj + 786432), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_26_v_proj"), 262144, 262144, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  all_tensors["layer_26_qkv_proj"] = layer_26_qkv_proj;
  char *layer_26_q_norm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_26_q_norm"));

  char *layer_26_k_norm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_26_k_norm"));

  char *layer_26_k_cache = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_26_k_cache"));
  all_tensors["layer_26_k_cache"] = layer_26_k_cache;
  char *layer_26_v_cache = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_26_v_cache"));
  all_tensors["layer_26_v_cache"] = layer_26_v_cache;
  char *layer_26_o_proj = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_26_o_proj"));
  all_tensors["layer_26_o_proj"] = layer_26_o_proj;
  char *layer_26_post_attn_layernorm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_26_post_attn_layernorm"));
  all_tensors["layer_26_post_attn_layernorm"] = layer_26_post_attn_layernorm;
  char *layer_26_gatedup_proj;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&layer_26_gatedup_proj, 12582912));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_26_gatedup_proj + 0), 262144, model_tensors.at("layer_26_gate_proj"), 131072, 131072, 48, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_26_gatedup_proj + 131072), 262144, model_tensors.at("layer_26_up_proj"), 131072, 131072, 48, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  all_tensors["layer_26_gatedup_proj"] = layer_26_gatedup_proj;
  char *layer_26_down_proj = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_26_down_proj"));
  all_tensors["layer_26_down_proj"] = layer_26_down_proj;
  char *layer_27_input_layernorm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_27_input_layernorm"));
  all_tensors["layer_27_input_layernorm"] = layer_27_input_layernorm;
  char *layer_27_qkv_proj;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&layer_27_qkv_proj, 8388608));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_27_qkv_proj + 0), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_27_q_proj"), 524288, 524288, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_27_qkv_proj + 524288), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_27_k_proj"), 262144, 262144, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_27_qkv_proj + 786432), 1048576, model_tensors.at("layer_27_v_proj"), 262144, 262144, 8, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  all_tensors["layer_27_qkv_proj"] = layer_27_qkv_proj;
  char *layer_27_q_norm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_27_q_norm"));
  all_tensors["layer_27_q_norm"] = layer_27_q_norm;
  char *layer_27_k_norm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_27_k_norm"));
  all_tensors["layer_27_k_norm"] = layer_27_k_norm;
  char *layer_27_k_cache = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_27_k_cache"));
  all_tensors["layer_27_k_cache"] = layer_27_k_cache;

  all_tensors["layer_27_v_cache"] = layer_27_v_cache;

  all_tensors["layer_27_o_proj"] = layer_27_o_proj;
  char *layer_27_post_attn_layernorm = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_27_post_attn_layernorm"));
  all_tensors["layer_27_post_attn_layernorm"] = layer_27_post_attn_layernorm;
  char *layer_27_gatedup_proj;
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&layer_27_gatedup_proj, 12582912));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_27_gatedup_proj + 0), 262144, model_tensors.at("layer_27_gate_proj"), 131072, 131072, 48, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(reinterpret_cast<void *>(layer_27_gatedup_proj + 131072), 262144, model_tensors.at("layer_27_up_proj"), 131072, 131072, 48, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice));
  all_tensors["layer_27_gatedup_proj"] = layer_27_gatedup_proj;
  char *layer_27_down_proj = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("layer_27_down_proj"));
  all_tensors["layer_27_down_proj"] = layer_27_down_proj;
  char *model_norm_weight = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("model_norm_weight"));
  all_tensors["model_norm_weight"] = model_norm_weight;
  char *lm_head = static_cast<char*>(model_tensors.at("lm_head"));
  all_tensors["lm_head"] = lm_head;
  all_tensors["nullptr"] = nullptr;
  construct_task_graph(num_gpus, my_gpu_id, all_tasks, all_events, first_tasks, all_tensors);
  cudaDeviceSynchronize();
}

__device__ __forceinline__
void _execute_task(TaskDesc const* task_desc,
                   RuntimeConfig const &runtime_config) {
  if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_EMBEDDING && task_desc->variant_id == 0) {
      kernel::embedding_kernel<bfloat16, 8, 1024, 1024>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[1],
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0]);

  }
  else if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_LINEAR_WITH_RESIDUAL && task_desc->variant_id == 0) {
      kernel::linear_kernel<bfloat16, 8, 64, 2048, 1024>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[1],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[2],
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0],
      runtime_config.qo_indptr_buffer[MPK_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_REQUESTS],
      runtime_config.my_gpu_id == 0);

  }
  else if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_LINEAR_WITH_RESIDUAL && task_desc->variant_id == 1) {
      kernel::linear_kernel<bfloat16, 8, 64, 3072, 1024>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[1],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[2],
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0],
      runtime_config.qo_indptr_buffer[MPK_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_REQUESTS],
      runtime_config.my_gpu_id == 0);

  }
  else if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_ARGMAX_PARTIAL && task_desc->variant_id == 0) {
      kernel::argmax_partial_kernel<bfloat16, 8, 1066, 144, 151936>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->output_ptrs[1],
      runtime_config.qo_indptr_buffer[MPK_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_REQUESTS],
      task_desc->task_metadata.task_offset * 1066);

  }
  else if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_ARGMAX_REDUCE && task_desc->variant_id == 0) {
      kernel::argmax_reduce_kernel<bfloat16, 8, 1066, 144>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[1],
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0],
      runtime_config.qo_indptr_buffer[MPK_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_REQUESTS]);

  }
  else if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_PAGED_ATTENTION_1 && task_desc->variant_id == 0) {
      kernel::multitoken_paged_attention_task_impl<bfloat16, 2, 1, 1024, 4096, 2048, 128, 512, 4096, 8, 0>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[1],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[2],
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0],
      runtime_config.qo_indptr_buffer,
      runtime_config.paged_kv_indptr_buffer[0],
      runtime_config.paged_kv_indices_buffer[0],
      runtime_config.paged_kv_last_page_len_buffer[0],
      task_desc->task_metadata.request_id,
      true,
      true,
      task_desc->input_ptrs[3],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[4],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[5],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[6],
      1e-6f,
      1e-6f);

  }
  else if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_SILU_MUL && task_desc->variant_id == 0) {
      kernel::silu_mul_task_impl<bfloat16, 8, 64, 6144, 3072>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0],
      runtime_config.qo_indptr_buffer[MPK_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_REQUESTS]);

  }
  else if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_RMS_NORM && task_desc->variant_id == 0) {
      kernel::rms_norm_impl<bfloat16, 1, 1024>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[1],
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0],
      1e-6f);

  }
  else if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_LINEAR && task_desc->variant_id == 0) {
      kernel::linear_kernel<bfloat16, 8, 64, 1024, 4096>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[1],
      nullptr,
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0],
      runtime_config.qo_indptr_buffer[MPK_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_REQUESTS],
      false/*residual*/);

  }
  else if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_LINEAR && task_desc->variant_id == 1) {
      kernel::linear_kernel<bfloat16, 8, 64, 1024, 6144>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[1],
      nullptr,
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0],
      runtime_config.qo_indptr_buffer[MPK_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_REQUESTS],
      false/*residual*/);

  }
  else if (task_desc->task_type == TASK_LINEAR && task_desc->variant_id == 2) {
      kernel::linear_kernel<bfloat16, 8, 256, 1024, 153600>(
      task_desc->input_ptrs[0],
      task_desc->input_ptrs[1],
      nullptr,
      task_desc->output_ptrs[0],
      runtime_config.qo_indptr_buffer[MPK_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_REQUESTS],
      false/*residual*/);

  }
}

#include <Python.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

extern std::string g_task_graph_json_path;

static PyObject *init_func(PyObject *self, PyObject *args) {
  PyObject *meta_list, *py_profiler_buffer, *tensor_names_list, *tensor_ptrs_list, *py_json_path, *kv_block_sizes_list, *kv_window_sizes_list;
  std::vector<void*> meta_tensors;
  std::vector<std::string> model_tensor_names;
  std::vector<void*> model_tensor_ptrs;
  std::vector<int> kv_group_block_sizes;
  std::vector<int> kv_group_window_sizes;
  int my_mpi_rank, num_workers, num_local_schedulers, num_remote_schedulers, max_seq_length, total_num_requests;
  long long eos_token_id;
  int allocate_nvshmem_teams;
  void *profiler_buffer;

  if (!PyArg_ParseTuple(args, "OOiiiiiiLiOOOOO", &meta_list, &py_profiler_buffer, &my_mpi_rank, &num_workers, &num_local_schedulers, &num_remote_schedulers, &max_seq_length, &total_num_requests, &eos_token_id, &allocate_nvshmem_teams, &tensor_names_list, &tensor_ptrs_list, &py_json_path, &kv_block_sizes_list, &kv_window_sizes_list)) {
    PyErr_SetString(PyExc_TypeError, "Invalid parameters");
    return NULL;
  }

  if(!PyList_Check(meta_list)) {
    PyErr_SetString(PyExc_TypeError, "arg1 must be a list.");
    return NULL;
  }
  if(!PyList_Check(kv_block_sizes_list)) {
    PyErr_SetString(PyExc_TypeError, "kv_group_block_sizes must be a list.");
    return NULL;
  }
  Py_ssize_t num_kv_groups = PyList_Size(kv_block_sizes_list);
  for(Py_ssize_t i = 0; i < num_kv_groups; i++) {
    long bs = PyLong_AsLong(PyList_GetItem(kv_block_sizes_list, i));
    if (bs <= 0) {
      PyErr_Format(PyExc_ValueError, "kv_group_block_sizes[%zd] must be a positive int", i);
      return NULL;
    }
    kv_group_block_sizes.push_back((int)bs);
  }
  if(!PyList_Check(kv_window_sizes_list) || PyList_Size(kv_window_sizes_list) != num_kv_groups) {
    PyErr_SetString(PyExc_TypeError, "kv_group_window_sizes must be a list, one entry per KV group.");
    return NULL;
  }
  for(Py_ssize_t i = 0; i < num_kv_groups; i++) {
    long ws = PyLong_AsLong(PyList_GetItem(kv_window_sizes_list, i));
    if (ws < 0) {
      PyErr_Format(PyExc_ValueError, "kv_group_window_sizes[%zd] must be >= 0 (0 = full attention)", i);
      return NULL;
    }
    kv_group_window_sizes.push_back((int)ws);
  }
  if(!PyList_Check(tensor_names_list)) {
    PyErr_SetString(PyExc_TypeError, "tensor_names must be a list.");
    return NULL;
  }
  if(!PyList_Check(tensor_ptrs_list)) {
    PyErr_SetString(PyExc_TypeError, "tensor_ptrs must be a list.");
    return NULL;
  }

  Py_ssize_t meta_size = PyList_Size(meta_list);
  for(Py_ssize_t i = 0; i < meta_size; i++) {
    PyObject *item = PyList_GetItem(meta_list, i);
    void* tensor = PyLong_AsVoidPtr(item);
    if(!tensor) {
      PyErr_Format(PyExc_TypeError, "Failed to convert item %d (meta) to void pointer", i);
      return NULL;
    }
    meta_tensors.push_back(PyLong_AsVoidPtr(item));
  }
  profiler_buffer = PyLong_AsVoidPtr(py_profiler_buffer);

  Py_ssize_t num_tensors = PyList_Size(tensor_names_list);
  for(Py_ssize_t i = 0; i < num_tensors; i++) {
    PyObject *name_item = PyList_GetItem(tensor_names_list, i);
    PyObject *ptr_item = PyList_GetItem(tensor_ptrs_list, i);

    const char *name_str = PyUnicode_AsUTF8(name_item);
    if (!name_str) {
      PyErr_Format(PyExc_TypeError, "Failed to convert tensor name %d to string", i);
      return NULL;
    }
    model_tensor_names.push_back(std::string(name_str));

    void *ptr = PyLong_AsVoidPtr(ptr_item);
    model_tensor_ptrs.push_back(ptr);
  }

  if (PyUnicode_Check(py_json_path)) {
    const char *json_path = PyUnicode_AsUTF8(py_json_path);
    if (json_path && strlen(json_path) > 0) {
      g_task_graph_json_path = std::string(json_path);
    }
  }

  init_persistent_kernel(meta_tensors, profiler_buffer, my_mpi_rank, num_workers, num_local_schedulers, num_remote_schedulers, max_seq_length, total_num_requests, eos_token_id, allocate_nvshmem_teams, model_tensor_names, model_tensor_ptrs, kv_group_block_sizes, kv_group_window_sizes);

  Py_RETURN_NONE;
}

static PyObject *init_request_func(PyObject *self, PyObject *args) {
  Py_BEGIN_ALLOW_THREADS
  init_request_resources();
  Py_END_ALLOW_THREADS
  Py_RETURN_NONE;
}

static PyObject *launch_func(PyObject *self, PyObject *args) {
  PyObject *py_stream;
  cudaStream_t stream;
  if (!PyArg_ParseTuple(args, "O", &py_stream)) {
    PyErr_SetString(PyExc_TypeError, "Invalid parameters");
    return NULL;
  }
  stream = (cudaStream_t)PyLong_AsVoidPtr(py_stream);
  launch_persistent_kernel(stream);

  Py_RETURN_NONE;
}

static PyObject *wait_func(PyObject *self, PyObject *args) {
  cudaError_t err;
  Py_BEGIN_ALLOW_THREADS
  err = wait_persistent_kernel();
  Py_END_ALLOW_THREADS
  if (err != cudaSuccess) {
    PyErr_Format(PyExc_RuntimeError,
                 "persistent kernel failed: %s",
                 cudaGetErrorString(err));
    return NULL;
  }
  Py_RETURN_NONE;
}

static PyObject *finalize_func(PyObject *self, PyObject *args) {
  finalize_persistent_kernel();

  Py_RETURN_NONE;
}

static PyObject *load_i32_acquire(PyObject *self, PyObject *args) {
  PyObject *py_ptr;
  Py_ssize_t index;
  if (!PyArg_ParseTuple(args, "On", &py_ptr, &index)) {
    return NULL;
  }
  auto *ptr = static_cast<int32_t *>(PyLong_AsVoidPtr(py_ptr));
  if (PyErr_Occurred()) {
    return NULL;
  }
  int32_t value = __atomic_load_n(ptr + index, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
  return PyLong_FromLong(value);
}

static PyObject *store_i32_release(PyObject *self, PyObject *args) {
  PyObject *py_ptr;
  Py_ssize_t index;
  int value;
  if (!PyArg_ParseTuple(args, "Oni", &py_ptr, &index, &value)) {
    return NULL;
  }
  auto *ptr = static_cast<int32_t *>(PyLong_AsVoidPtr(py_ptr));
  if (PyErr_Occurred()) {
    return NULL;
  }
  __atomic_store_n(ptr + index, static_cast<int32_t>(value), __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
  Py_RETURN_NONE;
}

static PyMethodDef ModuleMethods[] = {
  {"init_func", init_func, METH_VARARGS, "initialize persistent kernel"},
  {"init_request_func", init_request_func, METH_VARARGS, "initialize request resources"},
  {"launch_func", launch_func, METH_VARARGS, "launch persistent kernel"},
  {"wait_func", wait_func, METH_NOARGS, "wait for persistent kernel"},
  {"finalize_func", finalize_func, METH_VARARGS, "finalize persistent kernel"},
  {"load_i32_acquire", load_i32_acquire, METH_VARARGS, "acquire-load int32"},
  {"store_i32_release", store_i32_release, METH_VARARGS, "release-store int32"},
  {NULL, NULL, 0, NULL} // sentinel
};

static struct PyModuleDef ModuleDef = {
  PyModuleDef_HEAD_INIT,
  "__mirage_launcher",
  NULL, //documentation
  -1, //size
  ModuleMethods,
  NULL, // m_slots
  NULL, // m_traverse
  NULL, // m_clear
  NULL  // m_free
};

PyMODINIT_FUNC PyInit___mirage_launcher(void) {
  PyObject *m = PyModule_Create(&ModuleDef);
  if(m == NULL) {
    return NULL;
  }
  PyModule_AddFunctions(m, ModuleMethods);
  return m;
}
